about: Databases and tasks for the teacher SQL tool. Each theme: two linked tables (schema and data as SQL), the equi-join, fields shown to 2 decimal places, and tasks. Task kinds: build (write or design it, then Check), fix (the SQL given is wrong; Check the corrected version), predict (the SQL given is run after the class predicts). tools/check_teacher_sql.py runs every statement in SQLite.

themes.name: Morag's chip van
themes.about: Morag's customers and what they bought. The same data as the SQL lessons.

tasks.text: List the forename and surname of every customer from Oban.
List the forename, surname and loyalty points of every customer with more than 100 points, highest points first.
tasks.solution:
SELECT forename, surname, loyaltyPoints
FROM Customer
WHERE loyaltyPoints > 100
ORDER BY loyaltyPoints DESC;

tasks.text: List the town, surname and forename of every customer, in alphabetical order of town and then of surname.
List the surname of the customer and the item for every purchase costing more than £5 made on or after 5 October 2026 (dates are written "2026-10-05").
tasks.solution:
SELECT surname, item
FROM Customer, Purchase
WHERE Customer.customerID = Purchase.customerID
AND cost > 5
AND purchaseDate >= "2026-10-05";

tasks.text: Add a new customer: customer 11 is Shona Reid from Mallaig, with 0 loyalty points.
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Customer VALUES (11, "Shona", "Reid", "Mallaig", 0);

tasks.text: Callum Murray (customer 4) has moved to Oban and has earned 20 loyalty points. Update both fields.
Purchase 114 was entered by mistake. Delete it.
tasks.solution:
DELETE FROM Purchase
WHERE purchaseID = 114;

tasks.text: Rory MacLeod (customer 6) has moved to Inverness. This UPDATE changes more than his record. Run it, see what goes wrong, then fix it.
Callum Murray (customer 4) has asked to be removed from the database. This DELETE is refused. Why? Fix it so his record is removed.
Predict the output: which records, and in what order?
Predict how many records this shows, then run it. Why so many?

themes.name: Library
themes.about: Authors and their books. The same data as the Set 1 database questions.

tasks.text: List the title of every Crime book.
List the title and number of pages of every Fantasy book with more than 450 pages, longest first.
tasks.solution:
SELECT title, pages
FROM Book
WHERE genre = "Fantasy" AND pages > 450
ORDER BY pages DESC;

tasks.text: List the genre, title and pages of every book, in alphabetical order of genre, with the longest book first within each genre.
List the title and the author's surname for every book by an author from Scotland, in alphabetical order of title.
tasks.solution:
SELECT title, surname
FROM Author, Book
WHERE Author.authorID = Book.authorID
AND country = "Scotland"
ORDER BY title ASC;

tasks.text: Add a new book: B011, "Puffin Patrol", genre Children, 96 pages, published 2024, by Ailsa Campbell (author 5).
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Book VALUES ("B011", "Puffin Patrol", "Children", 96, 2024, 5);

tasks.text: Offside (B010) has been reprinted. It was published again in 2025 and now has 192 pages. Update both fields.
The library is removing every Sport book published before 2010. Delete them.
tasks.solution:
DELETE FROM Book
WHERE genre = "Sport" AND published < 2010;

tasks.text: Selkie Shore is by Ailsa Campbell. This INSERT is refused. Why? Fix it.
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Book VALUES ("B011", "Selkie Shore", "Fantasy", 330, 2024, 5);

tasks.text: Predict the output.
tasks.sql:
SELECT surname, title
FROM Author, Book
WHERE Author.authorID = Book.authorID
AND country = "Ireland";

tasks.text: Predict the output: how does OR change things?
tasks.sql:
SELECT title, published
FROM Book
WHERE genre = "History" OR published > 2020
ORDER BY published ASC;

themes.name: Music festival
themes.about: Stages and the acts playing on them. The same data as the Set 2 database questions.

tasks.text: List the name and start time of every Folk act.
List the name and start time of every act starting at 20:00 or later, latest first.
tasks.solution:
SELECT actName, startTime
FROM Act
WHERE startTime >= "20:00"
ORDER BY startTime DESC;

tasks.text: List the name and capacity of every stage that is in the South area or holds more than 10000 people.
List the act name and stage name of every Rock act, in alphabetical order of act name.
tasks.solution:
SELECT actName, stageName
FROM Stage, Act
WHERE Stage.stageID = Act.stageID
AND genre = "Rock"
ORDER BY actName ASC;

tasks.text: List the genre, act name and minutes of every act, in alphabetical order of genre, with the longest set first within each genre.
Add a new act: A11, "Ceilidh Collective", Folk, 60 minutes, starting at 15:00 on the Ceilidh Barn (stage 4).
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Act VALUES ("A11", "Ceilidh Collective", "Folk", 60, "15:00", 4);

tasks.text: Bass Haar (A05) has moved to the Forest Stage (stage 5) and now starts at 22:00. Update both fields.
Pulse (A08) has cancelled. Delete the act.
tasks.solution:
DELETE FROM Act
WHERE actID = "A08";

tasks.text: The Bothy Bar (stage 3) is closing and its acts are moving to the Loch Tent (stage 2). This DELETE is refused. Why? Fix it: move the acts first, then delete the stage.
Predict the output: which acts, and in what order?
tasks.sql:
SELECT actName
FROM Act
WHERE genre = "Rock" OR minutes > 90
ORDER BY actName ASC;

themes.name: Highland Games
themes.about: Heavy-event competitors and their results at two Games. Distances are in metres.

tasks.text: List the forename and surname of every competitor from Braemar.
List the result ID and distance of every Hammer throw in 2026, longest first.
tasks.solution:
SELECT resultID, distance
FROM Result
WHERE event = "Hammer throw" AND gamesYear = 2026
ORDER BY distance DESC;

tasks.text: List the forename, surname and distance of every Stone put result over 10 metres.
tasks.solution:
SELECT forename, surname, distance
FROM Competitor, Result
WHERE Competitor.competitorID = Result.competitorID
AND event = "Stone put" AND distance > 10;

tasks.text: List the event, surname and distance of every first place, in alphabetical order of event, longest distance first within each event.
tasks.solution:
SELECT event, surname, distance
FROM Competitor, Result
WHERE Competitor.competitorID = Result.competitorID
AND place = 1
ORDER BY event ASC, distance DESC;

tasks.text: Add a result: result 113, Stone put, 9.8 metres, 2026, fourth place, by Jamie Ross (competitor 3).
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Result VALUES (113, "Stone put", 9.8, 2026, 4, 3);

tasks.text: Result 109 was measured wrongly. The distance should be 29.7 and the place 2. Update both fields.
Delete every Weight for distance result from 2025.
tasks.solution:
DELETE FROM Result
WHERE event = "Weight for distance" AND gamesYear = 2025;

tasks.text: Morag Bell from Ullapool (Open class) threw the hammer 33.0 metres in 2026 and came second. This INSERT is refused. Why? Fix it: she is not in the database yet, so add her as competitor 7 first.
tasks.solution:
INSERT INTO Competitor VALUES (7, "Morag", "Bell", "Ullapool", "Open");
INSERT INTO Result VALUES (113, "Hammer throw", 33.0, 2026, 2, 7);

tasks.text: Predict the output.
tasks.sql:
SELECT surname, place
FROM Competitor, Result
WHERE Competitor.competitorID = Result.competitorID
AND event = "Stone put" AND gamesYear = 2026
ORDER BY place ASC;

themes.name: Schools shinty league
themes.about: Four school shinty clubs and their players.

tasks.text: List the forename and surname of every Forward.
List the surname and goals of every player with more than 10 goals, most goals first.
tasks.solution:
SELECT surname, goals
FROM Player
WHERE goals > 10
ORDER BY goals DESC;

tasks.text: List the forename, surname and position of every player who plays Midfield or has scored more than 15 goals.
List the surname and club name of every Goalkeeper.
tasks.solution:
SELECT surname, clubName
FROM Club, Player
WHERE Club.clubID = Player.clubID
AND position = "Goalkeeper";

tasks.text: List the club ID, surname and goals of every player, in club ID order, with the top scorer first within each club.
Add a new player: player 13 is Lachlan Bain, a Defender with 0 goals, who plays for the Mull Kestrels (club 4).
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Player VALUES (13, "Lachlan", "Bain", "Defender", 0, 4);

tasks.text: Sandy MacLean (player 9) has moved to the Glen Affric Hawks (club 3) and now plays Midfield. Update both fields.
Kirsten Cameron (player 4) now has 20 goals. Run this UPDATE and look at the Player table. What went wrong? Fix it.
Predict the output, in order.
tasks.sql:
SELECT clubName, founded
FROM Club
WHERE founded < 1915
ORDER BY founded ASC;

themes.name: Wildlife survey
themes.about: Survey sites around Scotland and the animals counted there. Month is a number: 1 is January.

tasks.text: List the species and number of every sighting in June (month 6).
List the species and number of every sighting of more than 500 animals, largest number first.
tasks.solution:
SELECT species, number
FROM Sighting
WHERE number > 500
ORDER BY number DESC;

tasks.text: List the species and month of every sighting from April to August (months 4 to 8), in month order and then in alphabetical order of species.
tasks.solution:
SELECT species, month
FROM Sighting
WHERE month >= 4 AND month <= 8
ORDER BY month ASC, species ASC;

tasks.text: List the site name, species and number of every sighting at a Coast site.
tasks.solution:
SELECT siteName, species, number
FROM Site, Sighting
WHERE Site.siteID = Sighting.siteID
AND habitat = "Coast";

tasks.text: Add a sighting: sighting 213, one Pine marten, in October (month 10), at Loch Garten (site 1).
tasks.solution: INSERT INTO Sighting VALUES (213, "Pine marten", 1, 10, 1);

tasks.text: The puffins in sighting 205 were recounted: there were 700. Update the record.
This should delete only Gannet sightings of more than 1000 birds. Run it and look at the Sighting table. What went wrong? Fix it.
tasks.sql:
DELETE FROM Sighting
WHERE species = "Gannet" OR number > 1000;
tasks.solution:
DELETE FROM Sighting
WHERE species = "Gannet" AND number > 1000;

tasks.text: Predict the output.
tasks.sql:
SELECT species, number
FROM Site, Sighting
WHERE Site.siteID = Sighting.siteID
AND region = "Fife";

tasks.text: Predict the output: which comes first when two records have the same species?
tasks.sql:
SELECT species, number, month
FROM Sighting
WHERE number > 100
ORDER BY species ASC, number DESC;
